name: SikaRapid®-22 AU
tagline: Setting and hardening accelerator for concrete mortar and grout
summary: SikaRapid®-22 AU is a non chloride set and hardening accelerator for concrete, mortar and grout.
metaDescription: SikaRapid®-22 AU is a non chloride set and hardening accelerator for concrete, mortar and grout.

usage: SikaRapid®-22 AU is recommended for use in premix and precast concrete where fast setting and hardening time is required. As a result, SikaRapid®-22 AU allows: ▪ faster finishing of concrete surfaces ▪ improved early strength of premixed concrete ▪ faster slip-form production ▪ used in ready mix concrete in cold climates

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text: SikaRapid®-22 AU meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for Accelerator (Ac).

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Stored at temperatures between 5° C and 35° C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and from frost, shelf life is 12 months.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store SikaRapid®-22 AU at 5°/35°, protected from the direct sunlight

items.label: Dispensing
items.text:
SikaRapid®-22 AU is added to batching water or is poured into the concrete mix at the same time as the gauging water. SikaRapid®-22 AU may also be added into the agitator truck on site. In this case, the concrete should then be mixed for an extra 1 minute for every cubic metre of concrete. The concrete should then be checked visually for uniform consistency before discharging.
Do not add SikaRapid®-22 AU to dry mix.

items.label: Compatibility
items.text:
SikaRapid®-22 AU can be used in conjunction with any non-retarded Sika Concrete admixtures.
It is beneficial to add SikaRapid®-22 AU with the initial mixing. Tests must be carried out to determine the optimum batching sequence. Do not use SikaRapid®-22 AU in conjunction with shrinkage compensating admixtures (i.e expanding agents).

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text: Typical dosage range is 500ml - 2000ml/100 kg of total cementitious material. Exact dosage rate should be determined by site trials.

rel.s: Sika® Set Accelerator is a calcium-chloride based admixture used to reduce the setting time of concrete.
a: Reduced initial setting time of concrete.
Improved early strength development of concrete.
Reduction of delays due to cold weather.
Reduction of concrete bleed (due to faster set)
Earlier stripping times.
